blocks.heading: Four Questions Before You Pick One Course

items.text: Nine paths is still too many to compare in your head at once.

Do you want a case-and-group MBA classroom, a reading-and-argument-heavy law degree, a data-and-modelling-heavy Economics program, or a skill-first route where a portfolio matters more than a syllabus, like UX or data analytics.
Can your family fund 2 years of a strong-institute MBA or public policy program, or do you need real income inside a year.

blocks.heading: Why Stacking Beats Picking Only One Course
rows: MA Economics or MA Public Policy
Data visualisation and one statistical tool (R, Python, or advanced Excel)
Turns a pure research or theory profile into someone consulting firms and think tanks can actually deploy on live data, which is where the higher-paying roles sit.
3-year LLB
CLAT-PG and an LLM in a specific domain (IP, tax, or tech law)
A generalist LLB caps out faster than a specialised LLM. The specialisation, not the degree alone, is what firms pay a premium for.
PG Diploma in Journalism and Mass Communication
One demonstrated digital or social-strategy skill, SEO, analytics reading, or short-form video editing
Newsroom hiring has shrunk while digital and brand-newsroom hiring has grown. The pivot skill is what keeps the journalism training relevant to where the jobs actually are now.
Digital marketing certification
One real, finished campaign with reported numbers, plus depth in one paid channel
Employers do not hire the certificate. They hire the one campaign you can walk them through with actual spend, reach, and conversion numbers attached.
